I am a 52-year-old woman with no schooling in the SNNP region. This small plot of 0.06 hectares grows perennial crops and fruit trees, and I also intercrop here. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer for this plot, and perennial crops like these do not usually need it anyway. However, I will bring manure and compost from my homestead to mulch around the trees and plants, as this is what we have always done to keep the soil good. I use local varieties that my family has kept for generations, and I do not use pesticides or irrigation because there is no water scheme here and these crops manage well with the rains. My children and I will tend this plot ourselves when needed for weeding, pruning, and harvesting.
